fields.description:
Agents have the ability to edit tickets, changing the intended scope of work when a ticket fails the completion verifier. Sometimes these changes are valid revisions, and sometimes they are a shortcut that degradea quality. We mitigate this today by requiring a new plan review when the plan is revised.
When a plan review happens after a failed completion verifier attempt that was against a certified plan, we need to add a plan review criteria that detects an agent trying to game ACs without actually completing the work. 
We need to build in guidance to prevent false positives. Sometimes plans genuinely change or ACs are unsatisfiable as originally written. Our goal is to detect an agent attempting to narrow scope and abandon valid ACs rather than meeting them.
